MINUTES

  ADJOURNED CITY COUNCIL MEETING

  OCTOBER 24, 2017

An adjourned meeting of the City Council of Rolling Hills Estates was called to order at 5:12
p.m. in the City Council Chamber, 4045 Palos Verdes Drive North, by MAYOR ZERUNYAN.

City Council Members Present:  Huff, Mitchell*, Schmitz, Zerunyan and Zuckerman
  *Council Member Mitchell arrived at 5:50 p.m.

City Council Members Absent:  None.

City Staff Present:  City Manager Doug Prichard
  Assistant City Manager Greg Grammer
  City Attorney, Don Davis
  Planning Director David Wahba
  Administrative Services Director Mike Whitehead
  Community Services Director Andy Clark
  Assistant to the City Manager Alexa Davis
  City Clerk Heidi Luce

DISCUSSION ITEM: WORKSHOP ON GROUP DYNAMICS AND COMMUNICATION

The City Council heard a presentation from Jeff Bills of Confidence Consulting regarding the
critical elements of good governance and what factors contribute to making a governing body
successful. The presentation stressed the importance of respect, candor and trust in the decision
making process; as well as the importance of coaching, mentoring and self-evaluation.

Following the presentation and brief discussion, the City Council noted several opportunities to
apply additional principals of good governance to the City, including developing a Council self-
evaluation process, mentoring, dispute resolution processes and ongoing dialog between the
Council Members.

ADJOURNMENT

At 7:05 p.m., MAYOR ZERUNYAN formally adjourned the City Council meeting to a regular
meeting scheduled for Tuesday, October 24, 2017 beginning at 7:00 p.m.

Submitted by,  Approved by,

Heidi Luce  Douglas R. Prichard
City Clerk  City Manager
